items.difficulty_reason: 30 行、局部上同调的 Čech 表示：①目标重述为 remark 中规范映射的同构性；F^bullet ∈ D_Z ⇒ complexes-with-support 引理给 i_*R H_Z(F^bullet) = F^bullet（不动性）；②Čech 项的态射 U_{i_0…i_p} → X 仿射（局部上取 f 的乘积之逆）⇒ relative-affine-vanishing 把 F_{i_0…i_p} 等同于导出推前；③sections-support 引理给 R H_Z(F_{i_0…i_p}) = 0 ⇒ i_*R H_Z(F^p) = 0 (p>0)；④拼装 F^bullet = i_*R H_Z(F^bullet) = i_*R H_Z(F)。承重全在 span 内；6 处引用（3 同章 remark/equation、3 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-extended-alternating-represented (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1184-1191

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the reduction to showing the canonical map is an isomorphism, the fixed-point property of complexes supported on Z under the local cohomology functor, the affine computation of the terms of the Cech complex as derived pushforwards, the vanishing of local cohomology on the terms supported away from Z, and the assembly into the claimed representation (source lines 1193-1222)
